description: Shared cases for the working copy's edit vocabulary (packages/aia_core/src/aia_core/domain/edit_ops.py; ADR 0029 decision 1; working-copy-edit-ops WCE0). Read by packages/aia_core/tests/test_edit_ops.py and apps/web/src/lib/edit-ops.cases.test.ts. catalogue: the closed operation set. apply: an edit on a working copy and what the server's apply_edit makes of it, or the word it refuses with; ids are the suffixes new ids take, in order (a new section's id first, then its question's). text_edits: the text-only marker that bounds the default automatic accept. touches, lock and whole_copy_lock: the server's alone (the web decides neither); touches name items by their stable ids (domain/item_ids.py: a list entry's id derived from its wording when the copy keeps none), and an added item by the placeholder new id (Q_new, sec_new). link_keys and research_questions_of: the trace's reading, held to research_trace and analysis.native. Fictional content.

apply.name: title keeps the analysis
apply.note: A title is wording: the analysis made of the brief stays.

apply.name: goal clears the analysis
apply.note: The analysis was made of the brief as it was.

apply.name: a briefing field clears the analysis
apply.note: Every briefing field is the brief too.

apply.name: the problem summary writes both homes
apply.note: content.research_plan and the analysis, and the plan is marked changed by hand.

apply.name: the problem summary starts the analysis from the plan
apply.note: With no analysis, it starts from the plan.

apply.name: the problem summary with no plan
apply.note: No plan yet: both homes start empty.

apply.name: a research question added
apply.note: Only the list it changes is written, to both homes; the analysis' other lists are not copied over the plan's.

apply.name: an objective added reads the analysis' list
apply.note: The working analysis is read first.

apply.name: a list item already there
apply.note: Compared whitespace-collapsed and casefolded.

apply.name: a research question reworded
apply.note: The old text is found as items compare; the new text is written as given.

apply.name: a hypothesis removed
an item that is not there
apply.note: Never a guess: nothing is removed in its place.

apply.name: a selection question added to a section
a question added with no questions section
apply.note: The section is made first, then the question; both ids are new.

apply.name: a scale added with its default ends
a scale added with its two ends
an open question added
a question added to a section that is not there
a question added to a tracked set
apply.note: A battery is not a questions section.

apply.name: a question reworded
a selection question re-optioned
options on a scale
apply.note: Refused, never accepted as a change of nothing.

apply.name: a question that is not there
a question removed
the sample size
a condition set on a later question
apply.note: WCE13: a display condition on an earlier choice question and an answer it has, stored as the design's form.

apply.name: a condition removed
apply.note: No condition: the question is asked of everyone; the stored filtr goes, nothing else.

apply.name: a condition on a later question refused
apply.note: Only an earlier question: Q2 comes after Q1.

apply.name: a condition on a scale refused
apply.note: Only a choice question: Q2 is a scale.

apply.name: a condition on an answer the question lacks refused
apply.note: Q1's answers are Ano and Ne.

apply.name: a condition on no question refused
apply.note: Q7 is in no section.

apply.name: a condition for an unknown question refused
apply.note: The question to condition must be a stored one.

apply.name: a condition with a blank answer refused
apply.note: An answer of only whitespace names nothing: refused, never read as one.

apply.name: a condition on an id two questions share refused
apply.note: Never bound to the first of two questions stored as Q1.

apply.name: a condition on the don't-know answer set
apply.note: A question that allows it has the answer Nevím / neodpovím, as the compiler reads it.

a person's unlock lets it through
adding a question is not locked
a declared rating question's condition is locked

before any declaration nothing is locked
